```python
import requests

def fetch_reddit_comments(api_key, cursor, limit=7):
    url = f"https://www.reddit.com/api/comments"
    params = {
        "limit": limit,
        "after": cursor   # pagination cursor
    }
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
        "User-Agent": "my-reddit-client/0.1"
    }

    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

# Example usage:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"      # <-- replace with your real key
    cursor = "cursor789"               # <-- replace with your real cursor
    data = fetch_reddit_comments(api_key, cursor)
    print(data)
```

Replace `"YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"` with your actual key (`beta_key` in this case) and adjust the `cursor` value as needed. This script will return the JSON payload containing up to 7 comments starting after the specified cursor.
